```{=html}
<section class="page-hero">
  <h1>Application</h1>
  <p>Apply to present a poster, give a contributed talk or attend QSYI 2027</p>
</section>
```

QSYI 2027 welcomes researchers from **India and abroad** working in any area of quantum science and technology. **Participation is by application.** The organizing committee will review every application and select participants on the basis of **scientific merit** and **relevance** to the [themes](index.html#themes) of the symposium.

## How it works

```{=html}
<ol class="steps">
  <li><strong>Apply</strong> using the <a href="#application-form">application form</a> before the deadline.</li>
  <li>The <strong>organizing committee</strong> reviews all applications and selects the participants.</li>
  <li><strong>Selected participants</strong> receive an email with the decision and a <strong>link to register and pay the fee</strong>.</li>
  <li>Complete your <strong>registration</strong> by the <a href="#key-dates">registration deadline</a>.</li>
</ol>
```

## Types of application

```{=html}
<div class="qgrid qgrid-3">
  <div class="qcard">
    <h3>Poster presentation</h3>
    <p>For <strong>students</strong> (bachelor's, master's or PhD), <strong>postdocs</strong> and <strong>faculty members</strong>. The poster sessions are a chance to discuss your work with the speakers and other participants.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="qcard">
    <h3>Contributed talk</h3>
    <p>For <strong>early-career principal investigators</strong>, such as assistant professors and junior group leaders. Each contributed talk is <strong>20 minutes</strong> long.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="qcard">
    <h3>Participation</h3>
    <p>For <strong>students, postdocs, faculty and industry researchers</strong> who would like to attend the talks, colloquia and poster sessions without presenting.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Registration fee

```{=html}
<div class="qgrid qgrid-3">
  <div class="qcard stat"><div class="num"><span class="inr">₹</span>2,000</div><div class="lbl">Students and postdocs</div></div>
  <div class="qcard stat"><div class="num"><span class="inr">₹</span>3,000</div><div class="lbl">Faculty</div></div>
  <div class="qcard stat"><div class="num"><span class="inr">₹</span>5,000</div><div class="lbl">Industry delegates</div></div>
</div>
```

There is [no registration fee]{.hl-blue} for invited speakers and their accompanying group members.

## Key dates

```{=html}
<table class="dtable">
  <thead>
    <tr><th></th><th>Need a visa to visit India</th><th>Do not need a visa</th></tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><th>Application deadline</th><td>December 15, 2026</td><td>January 15, 2027</td></tr>
    <tr><th>Notification of selection</th><td>December 20, 2026</td><td>January 25, 2027</td></tr>
    <tr><th>Registration deadline</th><td>December 31, 2026</td><td>January 31, 2027</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```

After selection, participants will receive a **link by email to register and pay the registration fee**. Please complete your registration by the **registration deadline** above.

If you **need a visa** to visit India, please apply by [December 15, 2026]{.hl}. A conference visa can be requested only after the symposium is cleared by the [Ministry of External Affairs](https://www.mea.gov.in/), Government of India, and this clearance takes time.

## What you will need

- Your **name**, **affiliation**, **position** and **email address**
- The **type of application**: poster, contributed talk or participation
- For posters and contributed talks, a **title** and an **abstract**

## Accommodation

The organizers will arrange accommodation for **invited speakers and their accompanying group members**.

For **selected students and postdocs**, we will reserve a **limited number of rooms** in the IIT Madras hostels. You can request a room in the application form, and the room charges are paid by the participants.

We request all other participants to **make their own arrangements**. For travel information, see the [Visit Info](visit.html) page.
